scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @emily/server" "npm run dev --workspace @emily/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @emily/shared && npm run build --workspace @emily/server && npm run build --workspace @emily/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @emily/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @emily/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @emily/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/browser.test.ts tests/ux-browser.test.ts tests/gemini-browser.test.ts
scripts.test:deployment: npm run build && node --test scripts/deployment-preflight.test.mjs deploy/netease-bridge.test.mjs
